Bundled browser libraries (served locally; no CDN requests at runtime):
- jquery-3.7.1.min.js (jQuery 3.7.1)
- persian-date-1.1.0.min.js (PersianDate 1.1.0)
- persian-datepicker-1.2.0.min.js and persian-datepicker-1.2.0.min.css (Persian Datepicker 1.2.0)

Upstream package/license information:
- https://www.npmjs.com/package/jquery
- https://www.npmjs.com/package/persian-date
- https://www.npmjs.com/package/persian-datepicker

These are the exact browser distribution files used by templates/base.html. No extra download or folder is needed when using this patch ZIP. App fonts use locally installed Vazirmatn, Tahoma, or Segoe UI; no web font is loaded.
